name: build-toolchain-pins
body: Every toolchain that compiles or stages a frontend must be pinned to an exact version in a repo-visible place and consumed by both the CI release build and the split formulae/installer. A floating toolchain — unversioned Go, Node/npm, or Rust compiler — is a violation. JDK 21 (actions/setup-java) and .NET 10.0.x (actions/setup-dotnet) are the reference for what a pin looks like.
